title: Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)
tagline: Embedding with enterprise clients to discover, build, deploy and scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value
prereq: EAI-106 Large Language Models, EAI-107 Agentic AI, EAI-109 Data Engineering for AI; cloud and Git fundamentals
competencies: Translate a client's business problem into a scoped AI use case with clear KPIs, ROI and success criteria.
Prototype quickly on real customer data and prove value with an evaluation set built from the client's own examples.
Integrate and deploy AI securely inside customer environments: SSO, private networks, enterprise systems and compliance controls.
Run production systems, drive user adoption and feed field insights back to the product team as a trusted client partner.

units.title: The FDE Model and Customer Discovery
units.topics: Origins of forward deployed engineering and how AI companies use it today; FDE vs software, solutions and ML engineers; stakeholder mapping; discovery interviews and process mapping; data and systems audit; framing use cases, KPIs, ROI and success criteria; scoping statements of work; build vs buy vs configure; consulting communication and trust-building.
units.outcome: Produces a discovery report for a client: process map, data audit, prioritised AI use cases and a scoped problem statement with measurable KPIs.

units.title: Rapid Prototyping on Customer Data
units.topics: Getting safe access to data in restricted environments; connectors for SQL, REST APIs, document stores and SaaS tools; building RAG and agent prototypes in days; demo-driven development; from notebook to usable app (Streamlit, Next.js); building evaluation sets from customer examples; handling messy, partial and sensitive data.
units.outcome: Delivers a working prototype on a client's sample data within one week, with an evaluation set and a live demo to stakeholders.

units.title: Integration and Deployment in Customer Environments
units.topics: Enterprise integration patterns; SSO with SAML/OIDC and role-based access; MCP servers and APIs to CRM, ERP and ticketing systems; deployment to customer VPC, on-premises and air-gapped environments; containers, Kubernetes and infrastructure as code; CI/CD; data residency, DPDP Act and security reviews.
units.outcome: Deploys the prototype into a simulated client VPC with SSO, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and a passed security checklist.

units.title: Production Reliability, Evaluation and Adoption
units.topics: Observability, tracing and alerting; online evaluation and regression gates; guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls; incident response and SLAs; cost and latency management; user training and change management; adoption analytics; structured product feedback from the field to the core product team.
units.outcome: Publishes a runbook, a live dashboard of quality, adoption and cost, and a field-feedback memo with product recommendations.

units.title: Enterprise Delivery, Value Realisation and Capstone
units.topics: Measuring business impact against baseline; executive readouts and storytelling with data; expansion to new teams and use cases; handover, documentation and enablement; professional ethics, confidentiality and responsible AI in client work; career paths in FDE and solutions engineering.
units.outcome: Completes an end-to-end client engagement and presents an executive readout of measured business impact.

labs: Customer discovery role-play and as-is process map

Guardrails, evaluation gates and human approval for risky actions
Observability, cost tracking and an incident-response drill
Executive demo and ROI readout to a stakeholder panel

cos.text: Explain the forward deployed engineering model and translate business problems into scoped, measurable AI use cases.
Build rapid AI prototypes on customer data with evaluation sets drawn from real client examples.
Integrate and deploy AI solutions securely into customer environments with enterprise authentication and controls.
Analyse production quality, adoption and cost data to diagnose issues and prioritise improvements.
Design and deliver an end-to-end enterprise AI engagement that demonstrates measured business impact.

capstone.name: Client-Embedded AI Deployment
capstone.desc: student teams embed with a real or simulated client (an industry partner or a university office), discover a high-value problem, prototype on the client's data, deploy into the client's environment with SSO, guardrails and monitoring, drive adoption with real users, and present an executive readout of measured impact.
